items.description: `contracts.openapi.primary` points at `contracts/README.md`, which itself states that no OpenAPI contract applies. The field is required by the work-packages schema, so pointing it at the README is the conventional placeholder; no change needed.

In a repository whose HEAD is unborn (no commit yet), a staged line that exists in the working tree makes `git blame` fail with `fatal: no such ref: HEAD`, so why_trace exits 1. The Uncommitted line scenario requires exit 0 with status `uncommitted`. Reproduced: `git init; echo a > f.txt; git add f.txt; why_trace.py f.txt:1` prints `why_trace: git blame failed: fatal: no such ref: HEAD` and exits 1. `_blame` should report the all-zero sha when `rev-parse --verify HEAD` fails.

`_resolve_target` calls `abs_path.read_bytes()` unguarded. An unreadable tracked file (permissions, a FIFO checked in as a regular path, an I/O error) raises OSError and prints a traceback instead of the documented one-line stderr message with exit 2. Wrap the read and raise InputError.

Round-1 fixes verified: `_blame` now reports the all-zero sha when HEAD is unborn (re-running the reproduction gives status `uncommitted`, exit 0), and an OSError while reading the target becomes the one-line exit-2 InputError. The fix request scoped only why_trace.py, so regression tests for both paths belong in skills/tests/explain-code/test_why_trace.py as a follow-up commit; no further code change is needed.
